notes.content:
Corrected typos in certain scenarios.
 Fixed an issue where achievements could not be unlocked in certain environments. (If you have read all scenarios but have not yet unlocked the achievement, please update the game and open the title screen to obtain it.)

 Fixed the skip button in the Post-credits Screen

Added support for macOS
Improved direction in certain scenes
Fixed typos in parts of the scenario
